title: Error Analysis
outcome: By the end, I can explain error analysis using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Find an error cluster before choosing a controlled follow-up.
given: Candidate errors: bright-light photos1/8; dim-light photos3/6. Images and reference labels are fixed for this audit.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Inspect dim failures
steps.detail: Check blur, lighting and label uncertainty instead of assuming lighting caused every error.

steps.label: Plan controlled pair
steps.detail: Photograph the same approved toy scene in bright and dim conditions; hold device and framing fixed.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Photograph the same approved toy scene in bright and dim conditions; hold device and framing fixed. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.change: Dim errors fall to1/6 in a later same-case replay.
counterfactual.prediction: The replay’s dim error rate is 16.7%; it is development evidence if those cases guided the revision.
counterfactual.reason: Observed improvement on reused cases is not an untouched final generalisation test.

student_task: What evidence would support the claim that a change helps fresh dim-light images? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: Freeze the revision and test new appropriately labelled dim-light examples, retaining plant groups and comparable conditions. Changed-case check: The replay’s dim error rate is 16.7%; it is development evidence if those cases guided the revision. Observed improvement on reused cases is not an untouched final generalisation test.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: A slice difference suggests investigation; it does not establish a causal lighting explanation by itself.
review_note: Reviewed Error Analysis against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
